title: ks.world: 10 agents, F2+ scenario, per-agent view builder
outcome: Pure agent functions f(seed, tick, view) -> <=1 envelope for the 10 ADR-06 roles, plus the scenario seed data and TickFrame.view builder
acceptance: 10 agents in agent_id order, RNG = sha256(canonical([seed,name,tick])); same seed twice -> identical envelope sequence (test)
View builder returns <=MAX_VIEW_ENTRIES ViewEntry per agent from the scenario scope; triage's view lists suppliers:S-17, not .iban (test_triage_view_excludes_iban)
Supplier registry and tick-0 prices present so invariants are non-vacuous (test_registry_nonvacuous)
